title: ITSY: Causal Discovery From Irregular Time-Series Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.23516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structural causal models for time series recover contemporaneous and lagged effects, but most methods require complete observation windows and become misspecified when samples are missing. We introduce ITSY, the first continuous-optimization method for causal discovery from irregular time series under a linear model. ITSY reformulates the structural equation so that prediction uses the nearest available history rather than the possibly missing current slice, and jointly imputes missing values while learning both graphs. A weighted reconstruction objective corrects the noise transformation induced by this reformulation. Across synthetic regimes varying missingness, scale, graph density, and noise, and on a real world benchmark, ITSY consistently improves graph recovery over representative SCM-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method. translated_title: ITSY：从不规则时间序列数据中进行因果发现
translated_abstract: 时间序列的结构因果模型能够恢复同期效应和滞后效应，但大多数方法要求完整的观测窗口，当样本缺失时会导致模型设定错误。我们提出了ITSY，这是首个在线性模型下从不规则时间序列进行因果发现的连续优化方法。ITSY重新构造了结构方程，使预测利用最近可用的历史数据而非可能缺失的当前时间切片，并在学习两个图的同时联合插补缺失值。加权重建目标纠正了这种重构所引起的噪声变换。在改变缺失率、规模、图密度和噪声的多种合成场景中，以及在真实世界基准测试上，ITSY在因果图恢复方面始终优于代表性的基于SCM的基线方法，证明了所提方法的有效性。这些结果为不规则线性一阶（动态）问题建立了一个有针对性的解决方案。
tldr: ITSY是首个针对不规则时间序列数据的连续优化因果发现方法，通过重构结构方程以利用最近可用历史进行预测并联合插补缺失值，在线性模型下显著提升了因果图的恢复效果。
en_tdlr: ITSY is the first continuous-optimization method for causal discovery from irregular time-series data under a linear model, which reformulates structural equations to use the nearest available history and jointly imputes missing values, consistently improving graph recovery over SCM-based baselines.
